sanskrit:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे।।
image_english: You are the supreme primal objective, the ultimate resting place, and the maintainer of eternal religion.
caption:
Chapter 11, Verse 18

Arjuna deduces the truth. ‘tvam akṣaraṁ paramaṁ veditavyaṁ’ (You are the supreme primal objective). ‘tvam asya viśvasya paraṁ nidhānam’ (You are the ultimate resting place of all this universe). ‘tvam avyayaḥ śāśvata-dharma-goptā’ (You are inexhaustible, and You are the oldest, the maintainer of religion). ‘sanātanas tvam puruṣo mato me’ (I assume that You are the eternal personality). Seeing the structure of the cosmos, Arjuna realizes that Kṛṣṇa is the ‘Nidhanam’ (foundation) upon which gravity, time, and space rest. He is the ‘Gopta’ (protector) of Dharma.
